title: SQL Semantic Protocol
description: Parser-independent active multi-input composition contract for SQL Semantic Protocol.

join_equalities.description: Physical source-column equalities required by the composed row-condition contract, including their source relation instances, join kind, and originating layer.

sources.description: Direct query sources. CTEs and derived tables remain local sources while their supported semantics resolve through to physical dependencies, joins, domains, and lineage.

joins.description: Normalized joins visible to the query, including supported joins carried through referenced CTEs and derived tables. Equality-column operands in join conditions use physical source relation and column identities when every local projection hop is a plain column copy; unsafe mappings remain explicit through unknown expressions and diagnostics.

column_domains.description: Conservative source-column domains, including supported constraints propagated through CTE and derived-table projections to physical columns.

output.description: Final query output. With catalog schema metadata, wildcard projections over physical and local relations expand to concrete columns; otherwise they remain explicitly unresolved.

condition_exactness.description: States whether domains plus reported join equalities exactly characterize row membership before row-set shaping.

caseSourceDomains.description: CASE-local branch-selection domains. Direct local-relation copies preserve them, and multi-layer composition remaps them to physical source columns only through proven plain-copy identity hops. Unsafe composition hops become unknown. Query-level WHERE, HAVING, and QUALIFY domains remain separate and are not folded into CASE reachability.

tuple_equality.description: Rows are aligned positionally and NULLs compare as equal for set membership.

multiplicity_rule.description: Number of occurrences of the aligned tuple. Null means name alignment has no proven positional contract.
